subject: English
question_text: The meaning of the word snap in the passage is−
stimulus: Hi I'm Shyam. I'm from Magura. Though district headquarters it's a small town. I'm in grade I now in Chander Hat Bidyaloya. I love games and sports very much. My fathers was an athlete in his student life. He inspires me to follow his foot steps and take part in games and sports or do some exercise besides my studies. So I get up early in the morning and take a walk with my father almost everyday. We walk for about an hour. At school during break I paly kabadi, gollachut, badminton, table tennis and carom. Sometimes, I practise the high jump and the long Jump out side the school campus. Playing football is a passion for me. I like watching television too. I watch sports programmes on different TV channels during my free time. I'm a fan of National Geographic, Discovery and Animal planet for their documentaries as they are quite interesting as well as educative. Recently my father has present me with a camera as he was very happy with the result of my Junior school certificate Exam. When I hold the camra. I feel so excited. I wish I could be an amateur Photographer in future not to snap only personal photographs at different parties but to school our beautiful Bangladesh. I'm sure that soon photography will be my most favourite pastime. [Unit-2; Lesson-1]
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 120 — Srijanee Bidyaniketan, Dumki, Patuakhali
